rules.measured: 2026-09-17, pit2-p03-g17 + pit2-p03-g09, MI355X/gfx950 ionic, ordinary v2, EP16, H7168/K6, BF16->BF16, experts/rank16, QP2, MORI_DISABLE_IONIC_CCQE=1, live tokens=capacity=64. Fixed-incumbent quick sweep, three independent 7-rep/100-round head-to-head checks, then three plain-table ABA groups (100 rounds, warmup20, drop1). avg_latency_us is the mean of three candidate benches, with the shipped Combine16/10/8. Actual per-rank/per-round bandwidth means are recorded separately in the archived benchmark report and ABA evidence.
